member.name: T:DotNetCore.Collections.Multi.MultiDictionary`2
member.summary: Represents a multimap: a dictionary that allows multiple values to be associated with a single key. Adding, looking up and removing a single (key, value) pair runs in O(1).

remarks.para: Key equality is determined by the supplied at construction (default: ). Keys are never keyed by their hash code alone, so hash collisions between distinct keys can not corrupt the map. null keys are rejected with (standard behaviour); null values are allowed.

The inner per-key collection is created by a configurable factory: by default a that allows duplicate values, or a when allowDuplicateValues is false. An inner collection is dropped automatically once it becomes empty, so the map never holds value-less keys.
This class is not thread-safe. Wrap it with external synchronization for concurrent use.

member.summary: Represents a multiset (bag): an unordered collection that allows duplicate elements and tracks the number of occurrences (copies) of each element. Adding, looking up and removing a single copy of an element runs in O(1).

This class is not thread-safe. Wrap it with external synchronization for concurrent use.
